import pandas as pd

# Read the intermediate joined table (result of joining Source1_74_0 and Source1_74_1 on calaccess_committee_id)
intermediate_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_74/intermediate_step1.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(intermediate_path)

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema:
# Target schema:
# ['ocd_prop_id': string,
#  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
#  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
#  'prop_name': string,
#  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
#  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
#  'committee_name_x': string,
#  'committee_position': string,
#  'committee_name_y': string,
#  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
#  'date_received': string,
#  'contributor_lastname': string,
#  'contributor_firstname': string,
#  'contributor_city': string,
#  'contributor_state': string,
#  'contributor_zip': string,
#  'contributor_employer': string,
#  'contributor_occupation': string,
#  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
#  'amount': float]

# Convert columns to appropriate types:

# String columns (ensure no NaNs, convert to str)
str_cols = [
    'ocd_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'committee_name_x', 'committee_position', 'committee_name_y',
    'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city',
    'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation'
]
for col in str_cols:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = df[col].fillna("").astype(str)

# Integer columns
int_cols = [
    'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'calaccess_filing_id'
]
for col in int_cols:
    if col in df.columns:
        # Convert to numeric, coerce errors to NaN, then convert to Int64 (nullable integer)
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Boolean column
bool_col = 'contributor_is_self_employed'
if bool_col in df.columns:
    # Convert to boolean, treating NaN as False
    df[bool_col] = df[bool_col].fillna(False)
    # If values are not boolean, try to convert (e.g., strings 'True'/'False' or 0/1)
    df[bool_col] = df[bool_col].astype(bool)

# Float column
float_col = 'amount'
if float_col in df.columns:
    df[float_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[float_col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id',
    'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name_x', 'committee_position', 'committee_name_y',
    'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname',
    'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer',
    'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount'
]

# Some columns might be missing if source data is incomplete, add them with default empty or NaN values
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df.columns:
        if col == 'contributor_is_self_employed':
            df[col] = False
        elif col == 'amount':
            df[col] = 0.0
        elif col in int_cols:
            df[col] = pd.NA
        else:
            df[col] = ""

df = df[target_columns]

# Save the final target table
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_74/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
